title: globularia borjae
intro: Globularia borjae, commonly known as Spanish globe, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, respiratory problems, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits.
